relation_definitions.EQUIVALENT: Same specified outcome and all variants demonstrably mapped; never implies implementation completion. No such assertion made in this initial crosswalk.
relation_definitions.PARTIAL: Some outcome/variants overlap; stated remaining gaps prevent substituting one requirement for the other.
relation_definitions.SHARED-FOUNDATION: Common supporting contract only; does not satisfy the target user outcome.
